ic_name: HDMI / DVI TMDS (TI TFP410 PanelBus Digital Transmitter — subset)

bring_up_sequence.description: The programmable I2C serial interface (see Table 6-1)

test_cases_present: partial — the TFP410 datasheet defines explicit DC + AC electrical characteristics, input setup/hold timing, output rise/fall + skew + jitter, plus I2C register-access behaviour. These map to DVI/HDMI Compliance Test Specification categories.
derived_compliance_test_categories: Reset behavior: enable bit cleared; transmit-empty flag set; receive-flag cleared after reset.
Master mode transmission: write to data register + clock-cycle delay + N edges + receive-flag set.
Slave mode transmission: select line goes LOW + N edges from master + receive-flag set after last edge.
